deploy.startCommand: set -e; OWNER_DATABASE_URL="$NEXORA_MIGRATOR_DATABASE_URL"; if [[ "$OWNER_DATABASE_URL" == *"?"* ]]; then OWNER_DATABASE_URL="${OWNER_DATABASE_URL}&options=-c%20role%3Dnexora_owner"; else OWNER_DATABASE_URL="${OWNER_DATABASE_URL}?options=-c%20role%3Dnexora_owner"; fi; echo NEXORA_MIGRATION_ROLE_CHAIN_START; DATABASE_URL="$OWNER_DATABASE_URL" node -e "const {Client}=require('pg'); const c=new Client({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL}); c.connect().then(()=>c.query('select session_user || \'\:\' || current_user as role_chain')).then(r=>{console.log('NEXORA_MIGRATION_ROLE_CHAIN='+r.rows[0].role_chain); return c.end()}).catch(e=>{console.error(e); process.exit(1)})"; echo NEXORA_MIGRATION_GATE_START; DATABASE_URL="$OWNER_DATABASE_URL" pnpm --filter @nexora/database db:migrate; rc=$?; echo NEXORA_MIGRATION_GATE_RC=$rc; test $rc -eq 0 || exit $rc; pnpm --filter @nexora/api start
